claimlint v0.1.1 fixes false documentation-drift findings and Unicode output failures on Windows.

- Resolve configured Markdown attribute IDs, MyST cross-reference targets and MkDocs page routes.
- Report anchors that depend on generated API or template content as skipped coverage.
- Skip environment names without a literal local read: dependencies and dynamic readers may handle them.
- Search prose, supplemental RST and root changelogs before reporting missing environment mentions.
- Emit UTF-8 for text, JSON and GitHub output, including redirected Windows streams.

The same five pinned public repositories retained all seven genuine HTTPX broken-link findings.
All 75 previously reviewed false errors/warnings disappeared: 63 resolved statically and 12 became
explicit skips. Fifty regression and existing tests cover the supported behavior.

Install with `python -m pip install claimlint==0.1.1`, then run `claimlint check .`.

Default checks remain static. Generated content and skipped claims require separate validation;
the public-repository sample does not establish recall or general accuracy.
